primary: Taste Skill for anti-generic frontend design/build tasks
verify: Storybook for isolated component states when the project uses it

secondary: Snyk agent-scan for skills/MCP/config supply-chain gate
security.budget: deterministic-first; agent security review never replaces scanners

secondary: Chrome DevTools MCP for browser/runtime diagnostics
planning-with-files for complex task scratch state
memory.budget: retrieve-not-dump; benchmark memory systems before persistent activation

secondary: Promptfoo for prompt/agent comparison, CI and red-team evals
ai-ml.guardrail: choose the smallest eval tool matching the task; do not run Promptfoo and DeepEval by default for the same evaluation

secondary: qmd for local documentation/knowledge retrieval where useful
Caveman proxy only after local benchmark and privacy/security review
context-engineering.budget: measure tokens per successful task, not compression alone

secondary: Context7 for current external library/framework docs

primary: surgical agent patch for local change
secondary: Ponytail when the explicit goal is less code/simpler architecture
Alibaba open-code-review for dedicated automated review workflows
code-review.guardrail: do not duplicate a full review pass when existing CI/review tooling already covers the requested scope

primary: AG-UI protocol for agent-to-frontend interaction contracts
secondary: CopilotKit when a project specifically adopts its frontend stack

marketing.guardrail: for SEO/GEO/AEO tasks prefer claude-seo instead of loading overlapping SEO guidance from both sources

primary: Pipecat for realtime voice/multimodal agent projects

secondary: frontend design stack only when the deliverable is an interface rather than a diagram
